question: Can assigning part of the external training credit to short lives recover isolated two-object memory while preserving the new joint abilities?
parents: Each cohort keeps all six interspersed one-life 8000-step bodies. Pair the exact same parent graph and rule across arms. Start new Adam with lr 0.003 in both arms. All fast numeric and topology permissions stay open.
budget: Exactly 2000 outer updates per arm. Each update generates and executes both a short batch of eight geometries crossed with four independent A/B assignments and a long batch of four geometries crossed with eight assignments, for 32 realized outcomes per batch per birth. Both batches use the same pre-update inherited model and start independent lives. Assigned credit is always exactly one batch. Short and long life tapes match between arms, while their realized actions and rewards may differ after parameters diverge.
credit: Long-only uses all realized long outcomes. Mixed uses one short and one long batch per two updates in a seeded random order. Uncredited batches run without gradients. Both losses use binary positive outcome and a leave-own-geometry-out baseline; the complete sampled trajectories receive score credit. No outcome is supplied as a private label to the graph.
short: The native ordinary odor geometry exposes A then B once each. Wait four neutral ticks between and after supports. A geometrically independent seed selects one unbiased A/B terminal query per geometry. Resource is determined by the sampled action.
long: Use the existing interspersed one_life seven-support ticket and two serial terminal motor actions with conjunction payout. The first terminal choice has zero taste and still permits native writing. The second terminal choice ends the life.
measurement: Report the parent, each arm and paired differences using the original ordinary capacity card (128 geometries), the previously fixed disjoint one-life bank (96 geometries), and exactly the same serial two-action bank. Report ordinary A and B jointly, conflict A/B/mark jointly, all six cold probes jointly, and both consecutive actions rewarded, alongside hard/conflict strata. Pair common worlds and independent births before interval resampling. No tuning or model selection on test outcomes.
censoring: Use 2000 unless time prevents it. If censored, report the latest complete predetermined checkpoint shared by both arms and both cohorts. Stop work by 07:48 Asia/Shanghai.
